name: Discord VC
author: Marobotic
description: Live Discord voice-call status in the bar: a ping-coloured dot, the name of whoever is talking (your own when the channel is quiet), and a mic indicator driven by Discord's own voice detection rather than the local PipeWire source. Hovering shows the exact ping, the server and channel, and the voice endpoint.

barWidget.description: Voice call ping, speaker and mic state
